facts.label: Recusar com educação
facts.sub: Diga Sorry, I’m in a hurry. Recuse Thanks, but I’m not interested. Explique I already have a plan. Termine Thanks anyway. I must go now.

facts.label: Diga não com educação
facts.sub: Nos EUA, recusar uma oferta com educação é normal. Sorria e diga Thanks, but I’m not interested. Não precisa explicar demais.

facts.label: Dê um motivo curto
facts.sub: Um motivo simples ajuda: I’m in a hurry ou I already have one. Frases curtas encerram a conversa sem ofender ninguém.

pages.title: A polite no · 1/3
paragraphs: It is noon on a busy street in downtown Chicago. Nora walks fast with a bag and a sandwich. She has a meeting in ten minutes. A man in a red vest stands near the corner. He holds a stack of brochures and a big smile. He steps in front of her and waves.
“Excuse me, miss! Do you have a minute?” says Vic. “Sorry, I’m in a hurry. What is it?” says Nora. “I’m selling a new phone plan. It is very cheap.” says Vic.

pages.title: A polite no · 3/3
paragraphs: “No, thank you. I must go now.” says Nora. “No problem. Have a nice day!” says Vic. Nora smiles politely and keeps walking. The salesman waves goodbye and looks for another person. She arrives at her meeting two minutes early. After the meeting, she eats her sandwich in the park. She thinks it is good to say no kindly. A polite no protects time and respect.
